# Vendored third-party runtime

## `opencv.js` (OpenCV.js 4.9.0)

- **What:** the official OpenCV.js build — OpenCV compiled to WebAssembly
  plus its JavaScript bindings — so this app runs fully offline.
- **Source:** https://docs.opencv.org/4.9.0/opencv.js
  (downloaded 2026-11-09; HTTP 200, 10,257,309 bytes)
- **SHA-256:** `4d7b85e2e12ea0bd088f491c311d620a45b53d1489b7f065b4492a230bda243a`
- **License:** Apache 2.0 (OpenCV) — see the header inside the file and
  https://opencv.org/license/
- **Why vendored instead of a CDN link:** the app is meant to anonymise
  photos before they leave the device, so it should not depend on network
  access at all. A CDN load was also measured to fail behind proxies that
  block `docs.opencv.org` (verified in the sandbox: the browser's proxy
  returned `ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED` for every external host).
  To update: download the matching `opencv.js` from `docs.opencv.org`,
  replace this file, and update the SHA-256 above.
- **Do not edit this file.** It is a generated build, not project code.
